Kim — reviewed the redlines. High-level summary:
- HIPAA: adding a BA clause for the specific integration is acceptable. We should confirm that customer data flows that contain PHI are limited to the hosted dedicated environment and that KMS is enforced. Recommend a short addendum confirming scoped PHI processing.
- SCCs: swapping to Gigasoft's EU SCC wrapper is okay; we will append our standard technical and organizational measures reference.
- Indemnity cap: customer lowered the cap to 1x ARR and added carveouts for security incidents with unlimited liability for willful misconduct. The scope of carveouts is broader than standard and needs exec approval (finance + CRO).
- Data return/destruction: their timeline shortened to 7 days; we prefer 30 days operationally. Recommend counter to 30 days with documentation requirements.

Action items for routing:
1) We can accept HIPAA addition and SCC swap on the condition that indemnity cap carveouts are narrowed.
2) Need exec approval for any change to indemnity cap/limit language.
3) If approved, legal will prepare "Redwood_DPA_Final_for_Signature.pdf" and we can send via DocuSign.

I marked the precise clauses in the attached exec note.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: EXEC approval request: Gigasoft DPA indemnity cap & signature plan

Vivek — quick ask: Gigasoft requests lowering the indemnity cap as part of DPA redlines (see Exec-Approval-Note). Legal recommends we only accept if carveouts are narrowed; otherwise we should hold. They need an executed DPA to issue PO this week.

Key points:
- Revenue impact: small initial ARR (expected $18k MRR) but upsell potential.
- Timing: customer needs execution this week to meet their procurement cycle.
- Risk: unlimited carveouts for certain security incidents as written could expose us beyond standard risk tolerances.

Requested decision: approve modified cap to 2x ARR with tightened carveouts OR instruct us to stand firm and push for 30-day logic on data destruction and keep existing cap. If approved, we'll route finalized DPA via DocuSign and provide a copy to finance.

Appreciate a quick reply.
— Kim
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EXEC approval request: Gigasoft DPA indemnity cap & signature plan

Kim — approved with conditions:
- Approve modified cap to 2x ARR (for initial contract) provided legal narrows carveouts to: willful misconduct only and explicit exclusion for routine security incidents covered by our SOC 2 controls.
- Maintain Redwood's 30-day data return/destruction timeline; offer a 15-business-day operational exception for system exports if needed but require written confirmation of handoff plan.
- Sales will offer a one-time implementation credit of 10% off first invoice as a commercial concession to close quickly.

Please proceed: legal to prepare final DPA, I will greenlight DocuSign routing and accounting to expect the executed copy. Keep the HubSpot deal updated (GD-2026-309).

Vivek
